arxiv-2011-05519.title: Energy consumption forecasting using a stacked nonparametric Bayesian approach
arxiv-2011-05519.creator: Dilusha Weeraddana(✉), Nguyen Lu Dang Khoa, Lachlan O’Neil, Weihong Wang, Chen Cai
arxiv-2011-05519.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Dilusha Weeraddana(✉), Nguyen Lu Dang Khoa, Lachlan O’Neil, Weihong Wang, Chen Cai. In this paper, the process of forecasting household energy consumption is studied within the framework of the nonparametric Gaussian Process (GP), using multiple short time series data. As we begin to use smart meter data to paint a clearer picture of residential electricity use, it becomes increasingly apparent that we must also construct a detailed picture and understanding of consumer’s complex relationship with gas consumption.

arxiv-2204-13642.title: Trivalent Categories for Adjoint Representations of Exceptional Lie Algebras
arxiv-2204-13642.creator: Youssef Mousaaid
arxiv-2204-13642.description: Abstract . We consider the universal pivotal, symmetric, monoidal, 𝕜 \Bbbk -linear category, generated by a Schurian object with a skew-symmetric multiplication, and study some of its quotients. We show that these quotients give rise to either vector product algebras or representation categories of exceptional Lie algebras. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification 18M05, 18M30, 17B10, 17B25, 20G41 1.

arxiv-2206-05351.description: Abstract Josephson-like junctions, transiently established in heavy ion collisions between superfluid nuclei, few MeV below the Coulomb barrier, allow for the back and forth transfer of a nuclear Cooper pair of effectively charged nucleons and thus the emission of γ \gamma -rays.

arxiv-2303-06448.title: Uncertainties in critical slowing down indicators of observation-based fingerprints of the Atlantic Overturning Circulation
arxiv-2303-06448.creator: Maya Ben-Yami, 1,2* Vanessa Skiba, 2 Sebastian Bathiany, 1,2 Niklas Boers, 1,2,3 1 Earth System Modelling, School of Engineering and Design, Technical University of Munich, Munich, Germany 2 Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research, Potsdam, Germany 3 Department of Mathematics and Global System
arxiv-2303-06448.description: Abstract Abstract Observations are increasingly used to detect critical slowing down (CSD) to measure stability changes in key Earth system components. However, most datasets have non-stationary missing-data distributions, biases and uncertainties. Here we show that, together with the pre-processing steps used to deal with them, these can bias the CSD analysis.

arxiv-2307-01272.creator: James A. Sellers
arxiv-2307-01272.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by James A. Sellers. The starting point for this work is the family of functions p ¯ − t ​ ( n ) \overline{p}_{-t}(n) which counts the number of t t –colored overpartitions of n . arxiv-2408-14533.creator: Penghao Zhu, Shi Feng, Yuan-Ming Lu
arxiv-2408-14533.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Penghao Zhu, Shi Feng, Yuan-Ming Lu. Motivated by the abundance of symmetry breaking states in magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene and other two-dimensional materials, we study superconducting (SC) and charge orders in two-dimensional topological flat bands in the strong correlation regime.

arxiv-2502-09068.title: Efficient Quantum Frequency Conversion of Ultra-Violet Single Photons from a Trapped Ytterbium Ion
arxiv-2502-09068.creator: Seungwoo Yu, Kyungmin Lee, Sumin Park, Kyunghye Kim, Junhong Goo, Jeonghyun Park, Taehyun Kim*
arxiv-2502-09068.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Seungwoo Yu, Kyungmin Lee, Sumin Park, Kyunghye Kim, Junhong Goo, Jeonghyun Park, Taehyun Kim*. Ion trap system is a leading candidate for quantum network privileged by its long coherence time, high-fidelity gate operations, and the ion-photon entanglement that generates an ideal pair of a stationary memory qubit and a flying communication qubit. Rapid developments in nonlinear quantum frequency conversion techniques have enhanced the potential for constructing a trapped ion quantum network via optical fiber connections.

arxiv-2602-03928.creator: Indranil Banik, Harry Desmond, Vasileios Kalaitzidis, Sergij Mazurenko
arxiv-2602-03928.description: Abstract The inconsistency between the locally inferred Hubble constant and the value inferred from the cosmic microwave background assuming the Λ \Lambda CDM cosmological model has persisted, turning into an important problem. An emergent underlying trend is that this Hubble tension is driven by data confined to the very low-redshift Universe (typically z < 0.15 z<0.15 ).

pmc-11504484.title: COVID-19 phobia, personality traits and menopausal symptoms in women in the climacteric period
pmc-11504484.creator: Hülya Özberk, Dilek Bilgiç, Fatma Gül Arı, Mehmet Özeren, Melih Başoğlu
pmc-11504484.description: IntroductionMenopausal symptoms in women are influenced by personality traits as well as physical and psychological characteristics. The effects of coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) phobia on personality traits and menopausal symptoms in premenopausal and postmenopausal women were examined in this study.Material and methodsThe study was conducted in a cross-sectional and descriptive design with 410 women.

pmc-12516909.title: Xiaoxianxiong Decoction Attenuates LPS‐Induced Pneumonia in Mice by Inhibiting Inflammatory Response Through Activation of SIRT1
pmc-12516909.creator: Linfeng Shi, Jiayan Zhang, Yuntao Cai, Junyun Bao, Huichao Chen
pmc-12516909.description: Xiaoxianxiong decoction (XXXD) is a widely used clinical prescription effective in the treatment of pneumonia. The study investigates the efficacy and mechanism of XXXD in pneumonia. In the study, an in vivo pneumonia model was induced by lipopolysaccharide (LPS) in mice, and an in vitro pneumonia model was induced by LPS in A549 cells.

pmc-12588681.title: Large-scale profiling of antibody reactivity to glycolipids in patients with Guillain-Barré syndrome
pmc-12588681.creator: Robin C M Thomma, Susan K Halstead, Laura C de Koning, Eveline J A Wiegers, Dawn S Gourlay, Anne P Tio-Gillen, Wouter van Rijs, Henning Andersen, Giovanni Antonini, Samuel Arends, Shahram Attarian, Fabio A Barroso, Kathleen J Bateman, Luana Benedetti, Peter Van den Bergh, Jan Bürmann, Mark Busby, Ca
pmc-12588681.description: Guillain-Barré syndrome is an acute polyradiculoneuropathy in which preceding infections often elicit the production of antibodies that target peripheral nerve antigens, principally gangliosides. Anti-ganglioside antibodies are thought to play a key role in the clinical diversity of the disease and can be helpful in clinical practice. Extensive research into clinical associations of individual anti-ganglioside antibody specificities has been performed.

pmc-12617802.title: Clinical and Molecular Predictors of Response and Survival in Patients with Urothelial Carcinoma Treated with Enfortumab Vedotin: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
pmc-12617802.creator: Mohammed Altenni, Péter Fehérvári, Jakub Hoferica, Péter Hegyi, Nándor Ács, Tamás Fazekas, Judit Vargha, Viktor Grünwald, Christopher Darr, Péter Riesz, Péter Nyirády, Tibor Szarvas
pmc-12617802.description: Take Home MessageEnfortumab vedotin is an effective treatment in advanced urothelial carcinoma, even in less-selected, real-world patient populations. Our findings highlight the predictive significance of clinical and molecular factors, such as Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status, Bellmunt risk scores, and prior response to chemotherapy and immunotherapy.

pmc-13082652.title: Towards eco-friendly apple farming: Real-time codling moth monitoring using improved YOLOv10 and IoT integration
pmc-13082652.creator: Mohamed Zarboubi, Abdelaaziz Bellout, Samira Chabaa, Azzedine Dliou
pmc-13082652.description: Pest-related crop losses pose a critical threat to food security and sustainable agriculture, especially in apple orchards where the codling moth (Cydia pomonella) is a major concern. This study introduces an advanced pest monitoring system that integrates an improved YOLOv10-m deep learning model with Internet of Things (IoT) technology, designed specifically for real-time detection of codling moths.
